# Local Rekor verification fixtures

These files were generated locally for the EA-306 offline verifier-path tests. The two text tag objects use a fictional code-signing leaf certificate, a separate fictional root certificate in PEM text, and an isolated one-entry Rekor log. They are not gitsign-produced signatures and do not establish Sigstore production-root trust. The tags share the test signer and root but carry distinct artifacts, CMS signatures, and Rekor entries. They exercise CMS extraction, Bundle construction, successful SET, inclusion, checkpoint, certificate-chain, artifact and signature verification against a test-only root. Tests mutate the extracted entry's integrated time, SET and inclusion proof, substitute the second valid tag's entry, and replace the trusted root's Rekor key to verify fail-closed results.
